## EMST role: Environmental permit writer (state variant, lead level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:relatedMatch`, confidence 0.35, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R11-environmental-permit-writer/state:2654`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Draft enforceable, implementable binding instruments — lead L4
- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — lead L4 *(distinguishing)*
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — lead L3
- Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action — lead L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — lead L3
- Negotiate permit conditions, mitigation and agreements using interest-based methods — lead L4
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — lead L3
- Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs — lead L4
- Process permit applications and administer issued authorizations — lead L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — lead L2
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — lead L1
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — lead L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — lead L3
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — lead L3

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Draft a permit and its fact sheet so that each condition is measurable, enforceable and traceable to its legal or technical basis — 12.9% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Derive permit limits and conditions from the applicable technical standards and the facility's technical record, documenting the calculation basis for each limit — 12.5% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Review a permit application for administrative and technical completeness, issuing a deficiency notice that lists each missing element and its basis — 8.6% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Review an AI-drafted permit or fact sheet against the application record and permit template, correcting each condition that lacks a traceable basis — 8.6% *(critical)*
- Respond to public comments on a draft permit, revising conditions where a comment shows an error and explaining each decision in the response document — 4.3%
- Write policy or instrument language that states each obligation, obligated party, deadline and verification method so that compliance can be determined — 4.3%
- Test draft permit conditions or agreement terms against compliance-verification and legal-challenge scenarios, recording each term revised and why — 4.3% *(critical)*
- Review a project proposal to identify every authorization, consultation and review it triggers, recording the governing procedure version for each — 4.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Negotiate permit conditions or mitigation with an applicant, generating options that meet the governing requirements and recording the agreed terms — 4.3%
- Review automated eligibility and completeness checks on electronic permit applications, correcting misclassified applications before decisions are issued — 4.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Maintain permit records and electronic case files, tracking holders' reporting and expiry dates and referring missed conditions for follow-up — 4.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Verify each term of an AI-generated first draft of an instrument against the governing authority and record before the draft enters review — 2.2%

*Credential gates (draft):* Professional Engineer (PE), incl. Environmental and Civil (Water Resources) exams (preferred)
